text: The steel business company created in POSCO's 2022 group split runs steel production and sales as a non-listed company that is a 100% subsidiary of POSCO Holdings, and keeps the name POSCO.
short: POSCO (the steel company) is a 100% subsidiary of POSCO Holdings.

source.name: POSCO Group Newsroom: POSCO Confirms Conversion to Holding Company Structure
source.quote: a non-listed company that is a 100% subsidiary of the holding company, and retain the company name POSCO

additionalSources.name: POSCO HOLDINGS INC. (Formerly, POSCO) and Subsidiaries: Consolidated Financial Statements, December 31, 2021 and 2020 (Form 6-K exhibit 99.1, SEC EDGAR)
additionalSources.quote: Upon completion of the spin-off, the surviving company was renamed as POSCO HOLDINGS INC., and a new subsidiary, POSCO, was established.
additionalSources.note: Independent auditors' report (emphasis of matter on the spin-off of 1 March 2022).
